events.title: Iran War Escalation

events.reasoning: The escalation of the conflict between the US and Iran could lead to increased volatility in oil prices and global markets. On the other hand, gold is often seen as a safe-haven asset, and an escalation of the conflict could lead to increased demand for gold, making a long position on GLD a potentially profitable trade.

timeFrame.note: Monitor news and adjust position accordingly
